decision_scope: Source and license evidence for the fixed solver-oscm-pace2024-development-data product: 100 PACE 2024 Exact Track public instances, 60 medium test-set instances and 13 tiny test-set instances. Hidden judging data, solution and precomputed answers, the verifier, development tools, backends, complete development images and historical image layers are outside this record and retain their existing classifications.

combined_product.statement: 100个正式实例没有数据许可；73个测试集实例的MIT许可不扩展到整个合并产品。合并产品和派生镜像只能在本地准备，禁止公开上传。
combined_product.license_not_granted_statement: No CC0 or other data license is asserted for the 100 Exact Track instances. The test-set MIT license does not relicense the combined product or authorize public distribution of a merged or derived image.

exact_track_public_instances.archive_members: <N>.gr for N=1..100; exactly 100 regular files, no directory entries and no license file
exact_track_public_instances.family_coverage_limit: The properties page lists families for many graphs but supplies no complete per-graph author or family table; provenance is not inferred for every graph.

license_review.statement: No license from a paper, verifier, test set, or another PACE year is applied to this archive.

testsets.commit_subject: Fixed vertex numbers in some of the instances
testsets.archive_additional_members: Seven declared directories, the root LICENSE and README.md, and exactly 73 declared upstream .sol members are accepted for validation. Solution files are neither read nor copied into the product.

license.coverage: Only the 60 medium and 13 tiny test-set instance files. This MIT license does not cover the 100 Exact Track instances or any other task component.

transform.format: binary member copy from two fixed ZIP archives
transform.validation: Exactly 173 declared outputs; each output path, byte count, SHA-256 and mode must match the retained manifest. Duplicate, path-traversing, undeclared, linked and special archive members are rejected. Directories and upstream-only files must match the explicit recipe declarations.
